test.title: Test notifications
test.partnerMissing: {{name}}: not registered. They need to open Navana and allow notifications.
test.partnerMuted: {{name}} has “When the other completes” turned off.
test.localSent: Scheduled. Leave the app: it should show up in 5 seconds.
test.localBody: If you can see this, this phone shows Navana's notifications.
test.partnerBody: If you can see this, notifications from {{name}} reach you.
test.partnerOk: Delivered to Google for {{name}}’s phone. If they cannot see it, the problem is on their phone: they should open Navana and check in Android that the app’s notifications are allowed and that battery saving does not restrict it.
test.pushBody: If you can see this, notifications between phones reach this one.
test.noToken: This phone has no identifier to receive notifications over the internet.
test.pushOk: Delivered to Google: the notification should reach this phone now.
test.pushPending: Expo accepted it but has not confirmed delivery yet. If it does not arrive within a minute, try again.
test.invalidCredentials: The Firebase key (FCM V1) is missing or invalid in Expo. Upload it at expo.dev → Credentials → Android.
test.deviceNotRegistered: This phone's identifier is no longer valid. Close the app completely and open it again.
test.failed: The test could not be run: {{reason}}
test.registerFailed: This phone could not be registered: {{reason}}
test.partnerNotRegistered: {{name}}’s phone is no longer registered to receive notifications. They should open Navana on their phone and go to Settings → Notifications: it registers itself again on entering. Then repeat this test.
test.partnerFailed: It could not be delivered to {{name}}: {{reason}}
